ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the margins and central peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions on the left and right lobes; a central black wedge originating from the notch and tapering inward; continuous black pigmentation along the trailing edge; fine black stippling at the white-to-black transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with significant pixel amplitude across the entire trailing edge boundary; prominent jagged peaks at the distal ends and medium-amplitude valleys throughout.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing edge leading to acute, upward-tapering tips at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of circular, high-contrast nodules (barnacles) at both distal lobe tips; a single distinctive white annular (ring) scar in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark linear pixel disruptions; one prominent vertical scratch on the lower left lobe and multiple faint diagonal scratches on the interior white patches of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) causing textural deformation at both lobe tips; a circular scar on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density of barnacles at the tips creates an irregular, non-linear silhouette distinct from the primary anatomical fluke structure.
